title: Surreal Ouroboros Street
description: A surreal street scene featuring a large orange ouroboros snake coiled around a robed skeleton figure walking on a cobblestone road. In the foreground, a skeletal musician plays a violin while standing in a swirling orange and blue vortex, with a lamppost, European-style buildings, a tree with yellow blossoms, a distant domed basilica, mountains, and an astronaut floating near a crescent moon in the swirling sky.
prompt: Surreal fantasy street scene on cobblestones with a giant orange ouroboros snake coiled around a skeleton in a blue and green robe walking forward. In the foreground another skeleton plays a violin while standing inside a swirling colorful vortex. Parisian-style buildings line the street with a blossoming tree and lamppost. In the background are snowy mountains, a large domed basilica, swirling clouds, a floating astronaut, and a crescent moon in a dynamic painted sky.
